audits.dominantPattern: P5 preamble negation / P4 minimizer pivot in narration
clusterWarnings: L273: two kills in one paragraph (A-N06, A-N07)
'had done X before / never Y' shape repeats at L223, L295, L679
'nothing in / nowhere else' exclusion repeats L201, L239, L243
audits.keepRateNote: Keep rate ~56% exceeds the 20% guide heuristic. Re-examined: the surviving keeps are elimination steps in a contrast-group outbreak deduction (plan: Snow/Broad Street method), dialogue prohibitions, hard capability limits of the ward/light, and explicit free-indirect self-argument. See scratchpad.

findings.text: and again at the next stall, where there was no child at all, only a man selling salt herring out of a barrel.
findings.reason: Deletion test: 'where a man was selling salt herring out of a barrel' still tells the reader the tick is not coming from a sick child. The 'no X at all, only Y' sort is scaffolding.
findings.suggestedFix: and again at the next stall, where a man was selling salt herring out of a barrel.
findings.deletionTest: and again at the next stall, where a man was selling salt herring out of a barrel.

findings.text: She said it low, for him and not for the egg stall.
findings.reason: 'for him' already excludes the crowd; the next sentence (he had to lean to hear) proves the pitch. The 'and not for' half is dead weight.
findings.suggestedFix: She said it low, for him alone.
findings.deletionTest: She said it low, for him.

findings.text: Windrunner's voice did not change, going on at the same level, a woman telling him how far it was to the next ford.
findings.reason: Primes a change that never happens, then delivers the real fact. Start at the level voice.
findings.suggestedFix: Windrunner's voice went on at the same level, a woman telling him how far it was to the next ford.
findings.deletionTest: Windrunner's voice went on at the same level, a woman telling him how far it was to the next ford.

findings.text: Someone else said *Mam, Mam, Mam* in a flat voice, over and over, not loud.
findings.reason: Trailing 'not loud' bats away a descriptor nobody offered. Name the real volume.
findings.suggestedFix: Someone else said *Mam, Mam, Mam* in a small flat voice, over and over.
findings.deletionTest: Someone else said *Mam, Mam, Mam* in a flat voice, over and over.

findings.text: Every one of them, at the start, in the gut and nowhere else.
findings.reason: Repeats the exclusion the previous paragraph already made ('Nothing in the lungs, nothing in the blood...'). Third 'nowhere else / nothing in' exclusion in forty lines; the repeat instance is the cluster casualty.
findings.suggestedFix: Every one of them, at the start, in the gut.
findings.deletionTest: Every one of them, at the start, in the gut.

findings.text: Water did not glow like a body.
findings.reason: Preamble that tells us what the reading is not before giving it. The following sentence carries the actual reading. Paired with A-N07 (same paragraph, page-level cluster). Fix: delete; A-N07's fix names the water so the referent survives.
findings.deletionTest: The light went in and lay there, dull gold...

findings.text: The light went in and lay there, dull gold, holding no pulse but the slow pulse of the currents coming up through the floor.
findings.reason: 'no pulse but the slow pulse' refuses one pulse to land on another. State the pulse that is there. Apply together with A-N06.
findings.suggestedFix: The light went into the water and lay there, dull gold, beating with the slow pulse of the currents coming up through the floor.
findings.deletionTest: The light went in and lay there, dull gold, with the slow pulse of the currents coming up through the floor.

findings.text: Not Garran. The rest were early.
findings.reason: Two-beat fragment pivot; 'The rest were early' also restates 'Most of them were early' from the paragraph's first sentence. Name the exception directly.
findings.suggestedFix: Only Garran was late.

findings.text: and it wasn't in the chapel or on Tobin's slate. It was down there in who sold what to whom.
findings.reason: Refuses the wrong location before naming the right one. 'down there in who sold what to whom' carries the whole claim; the chapel/slate refusal is scaffolding.
findings.suggestedFix: and it was down there in who sold what to whom.
findings.deletionTest: That half would tell her whether this was one bad harvest gone wrong in a damp barn or something else, and it was down there in who sold what to whom.

findings.text: and at first there was nothing, only the dark wall and the beam, and then a line of yellow under the high door, thin as a thread.
findings.reason: 'nothing, only X' rejects a blank to land on the wall and beam, which are not nothing. Start with what she sees.
findings.suggestedFix: and at first there was the dark wall and the beam, and then a line of yellow under the high door, thin as a thread.
findings.deletionTest: and at first there was the dark wall and the beam, and then a line of yellow...

findings.text: It didn't tick here. It ground.
findings.reason: Classic 'She did not laugh. She smiled.' shape on the staff. 'Here' carries the contrast with the lanes on its own.
findings.suggestedFix: Here it ground.

findings.text: Never to a person.
findings.reason: 'once before ... to a wolf's hind legs' already establishes the wolf was the only time; the fragment then sets up 'A person made a different sound.' Same 'had done X / never Y' shape also appears at L223 and L295 (kept there as hard-fact first-times); this third repeat is the cut.
findings.deletionTest: She had done this once before, on the road at the holly bend, to a wolf's hind legs. A person made a different sound.

findings.text: and the puddle would not stay a puddle.
findings.reason: Negated preamble before 'It ran along the grain...' which carries the motion. Also gives the puddle a refusal verb. State the spreading.
findings.suggestedFix: and the puddle was already spreading.
findings.deletionTest: It had come out of the broken jar in a puddle no bigger than a dinner plate. It ran along the grain of the boards...

findings.text: She didn't look.
findings.reason: Preamble to 'She watched the sky instead.' ('instead' already carries the refusal). Delete; see A-W03 for the paired sky line.
findings.deletionTest: Crying again. She couldn't hear it. She watched the sky instead.

findings.text: No drag, no weight, no knot under the ribs; he had never eaten one mouthful of what he kept under that floor.
findings.reason: Triple refusal hallway ('No drag, no weight, no knot') building to 'just a boy, stopped.' Give the reading positively; the inference clause after the semicolon survives.
findings.suggestedFix: The light came back clean from his gut; he had never eaten one mouthful of what he kept under that floor.
findings.deletionTest: he had never eaten one mouthful of what he kept under that floor. There was just a boy, stopped.

findings.text: and wanting his night more, not less.
findings.reason: 'more, not less' is emphatic scaffolding; nobody proposed 'less'.
findings.suggestedFix: and wanting his night all the more.

findings.text: Smoke, but not wood smoke; heavier, and sour, with a scorch in it,
findings.reason: Rejects wood smoke to land on the real smoke; the bread-in-the-oven simile that follows identifies the source without the refusal.
findings.suggestedFix: Smoke, heavy and sour, with a scorch in it,
findings.deletionTest: Smoke, heavier, and sour, with a scorch in it, bread left in the oven while somebody stood talking at the door.

audits.dominantPattern: P8 body-part agency (hands/eyes/head carrying deliberate action)
audits.secondSweep: P5/P6 second sweep run sentence by sentence over all 1049 lines. Added A-I01 (village came), A-I05 (smell came out to meet), A-I06 (beds waiting), A-I09 (window looking), A-I11 (wire printed itself), A-I14 (planks talked), A-I18 (bars breathed), A-I08 (building got it). Body-part sweep added A-I02, A-I04, A-I07, A-I12, A-I13, A-I15, A-I16, A-I17, A-I19. No abstract states settling into body parts beyond the literal frost-cost mechanism (kept, subject matter). No receiver noun revised 'under the quill/on the page'. No metaphor chain across consecutive sentences except the staff (tick/woke/ground/shifted), kept as the chapter's established dowsing mechanism.
clusterFlags: L633-L657 granary approach: 5 kills (A-I13, A-I14, A-I15, A-I16 plus A-N11) - smart-POV high-risk zone

findings.text: The taste came before the village did.
findings.reason: Real agent: the riders came into the village; the village does not arrive. Pass A sweep target (geography with a motion verb).
findings.suggestedFix: The taste came before she saw the village.
findings.subject: the village

findings.text: and Lyriel's hand came across from the right and took the cheek-strap, Lyriel not so much as turning her head.
findings.reason: Hand carries the volition; trained reflex is still Lyriel's act, not involuntary. Test: 'Lyriel reached across' keeps the meaning.
findings.suggestedFix: and Lyriel reached across from the right and took the cheek-strap without turning her head.
findings.subject: Lyriel's hand

findings.text: She let that sit.
findings.reason: Closed-set permission tag ('let that sit'); slop checker cap 0. Sylvanas does one thing: she pauses.
findings.suggestedFix: She waited.
findings.subject: that (the word)

findings.text: His head turned to the pump, where the two women stood with their buckets, and then, slower, to the stall.
findings.reason: Brask is deliberately looking at his own street; the head is not acting on its own. Test passes with Brask as subject.
findings.suggestedFix: He turned his head to the pump, where the two women stood with their buckets, and then, slower, to the stall.
findings.subject: his head

findings.text: The smell came out to meet them.
findings.reason: 'to meet' gives the smell purpose. Real agent: air through the opened door.
findings.suggestedFix: The smell came out through the open door.
findings.subject: the smell
findings.realAgent: air moving through the door Dickon opened

findings.text: Some beds were still empty, made up and waiting.
findings.reason: Beds 'waiting' carries the expectation that belongs to Tobin, who keeps them for the next sick.
findings.suggestedFix: Some beds were still empty, made up for whoever came in next.
findings.subject: beds
findings.realAgent: Tobin, who keeps a bed for each expected case

findings.text: the thumb refusing to bend enough to hold it.
findings.reason: The stiffness is involuntary, but 'refusing' hands the thumb a will. Keep the limitation, drop the refusal verb.
findings.suggestedFix: the thumb too stiff to bend far enough to hold it.
findings.subject: the thumb

findings.text: and the long stone building had got it from somewhere, from somebody.
findings.reason: A building does not acquire flour; whoever keeps it bought it. Real actor omitted.
findings.suggestedFix: and whoever kept the long stone building had got it from somewhere, from somebody.
findings.subject: the long stone building

findings.text: each with a bubble in it, looking down the lane.
findings.reason: The window does not look; it faces.
findings.suggestedFix: each with a bubble in it, facing down the lane.
findings.subject: the round window

findings.text: The ward on Elsie wanted feeding.
findings.reason: Ward given desire. Real state: the ward had thinned and needed renewing.
findings.suggestedFix: The ward on Elsie needed feeding.
findings.subject: the ward
findings.realAgent: Jaina's spell thinning on its own schedule

findings.text: that the silver wire had printed itself through her bodice.
findings.reason: Reflexive 'printed itself' gives the wire agency; Jaina's grip pressed it in.
findings.suggestedFix: that she could feel the silver wire printed through her bodice.
findings.subject: the silver wire

findings.text: Sylvanas's hand had gone to the string of her bow.
findings.reason: Matches calibration 'Her fingers found the bowstring before she had decided to reach for it' (KILL).
findings.suggestedFix: Sylvanas had put her hand to the string of her bow.
findings.subject: Sylvanas's hand

findings.text: before her eyes made out anything at all.
findings.reason: Eyes carry the perceptual act. Test: 'before she could make out anything at all' means the same.
findings.suggestedFix: before she could make out anything at all.
findings.subject: her eyes

findings.text: The planks talked under her boots on every step.
findings.reason: Speech verb on planks. Physical fact: they creaked.
findings.suggestedFix: The planks creaked under her boots on every step.
findings.subject: the planks

findings.text: because Lyriel's hand at her back pushed her.
findings.reason: Lyriel pushed her; the hand is an instrument.
findings.suggestedFix: because Lyriel pushed her on with a hand at her back.
findings.subject: Lyriel's hand

findings.text: And then his hand went past the jar for the lamp.
findings.reason: Deliberate lunge for the lamp, not a reflex. Tam is the actor.
findings.suggestedFix: And then he reached past the jar for the lamp.
findings.subject: his hand

findings.text: His eyes came back to her.
findings.reason: Eyes as agent. Also an over-cap gaze beat (see A-T05). The repeated line of dialogue carries the moment; delete.
findings.subject: his eyes

findings.text: Close to, the bars breathed cold into her face.
findings.reason: Iron given breath. Physical fact: cold came off the bars.
findings.suggestedFix: Close to, cold came off the bars into her face.
findings.subject: the bars

findings.text: His eyes went up the lane toward the bakehouse.
findings.reason: Eyes as agent; also an over-cap gaze beat (see A-T06). 'The rest he worked out himself' plus 'His thumb stopped' already carry Brask's realisation; delete.
findings.subject: his eyes

findings.text: hair stuck to her forehead in dark points, eyes clear and frightened.
findings.reason: Eye/gaze emotional beats: 12 counted against cap 4. Generic 'frightened eyes' is the weakest; her line 'I'm warm now' and plucking the blanket carry the fear.
findings.suggestedFix: hair stuck to her forehead in dark points.

findings.text: Elsie looked up at the window over her head, the lane she couldn't see from where she lay, and said nothing.
findings.reason: Emotion (guilt) routed through looking; over cap. Use the hands she was already using two lines up.
findings.suggestedFix: Elsie twisted the edge of the blanket and said nothing.

findings.text: Sylvanas looked at her a moment. Then at the slate in Tobin's hand, with its square capitals. Then back.
findings.reason: Three-beat look sequence as reaction; over cap. 'Then she waited.' flows straight into 'How sure?'.

findings.text: He looked at her for the first time since the loft. Then at the boy on the floor.
findings.reason: Look-as-reaction beat; over cap. The dialogue 'Burn it, then' carries his decision.

findings.text: His eyes came back to her.
findings.reason: Over-cap gaze beat; same sentence as A-I17, same fix (delete).

findings.text: His eyes went up the lane toward the bakehouse.
findings.reason: Over-cap gaze beat; same sentence as A-I19, same fix (delete).

findings.text: Sylvanas looked at her a moment longer.
findings.reason: Generic lingering-look beat; over cap.
findings.suggestedFix: Sylvanas stayed a moment longer on the threshold.

findings.text: Brask looked at her. He didn't write that.
findings.reason: Look-as-reaction; over cap. The refusal to write carries the joke.
findings.suggestedFix: Brask didn't write that.

findings.text: He watched the light go in and out of his own stomach through his open shirt, frowning down at it.
findings.reason: filter_watched 8 against cap 3. Perception filtered through 'watched'; put the frown first and show the light.
findings.suggestedFix: He frowned down through his open shirt at the light going in and out of his own stomach.

findings.text: Jaina watched the spoon go to the old man's mouth.
findings.reason: Filter verb plus demoted actor (the spoon 'goes'; Tobin feeds him). Name the actor.
findings.suggestedFix: Tobin put the spoon to the old man's mouth.

findings.text: She watched the sky instead. Full dark.
findings.reason: Filter verb; apply with A-N14 (deleting 'She didn't look.').
findings.suggestedFix: Overhead it was full dark.

findings.text: and watched him a while.
findings.reason: Filter verb; the stance (arms at her sides, a step back) already shows the attention.
findings.suggestedFix: and stood there a while.

findings.text: Close to, it was worse: a long blind wall of fieldstone going up into the dusk,
findings.reason: punct_colon_narration 21 against cap 17; reveal-colon after a verdict ('it was worse') is the weakest use.
findings.suggestedFix: Close to, it was a long blind wall of fieldstone going up into the dusk,

findings.text: A bowl dropped over a candle: a shell of blue,
findings.reason: Over-cap colon; a comma does the same apposition.
findings.suggestedFix: A bowl dropped over a candle, a shell of blue,

findings.text: and something in the hand gave: a small tearing, low down in the palm,
findings.reason: Over-cap reveal colon; comma apposition carries it.
findings.suggestedFix: and something in the hand gave, a small tearing low down in the palm,

findings.text: It was the same. That was the first thing: the thing in Garran's gut
findings.reason: Setup-colon ('That was the first thing:') announces instead of stating. Over cap.
findings.suggestedFix: It was the same thing that was in Garran's gut

findings.text: The young man by the door had the smallest knot of all, no bigger than a walnut.
findings.reason: Third consecutive paragraph opening 'The' (L239-243); cap 0.
findings.suggestedFix: By the door, the young man had the smallest knot of all, no bigger than a walnut.

findings.text: She tried to tuck the end under, and it slid out.
findings.reason: Three consecutive 'She' paragraph openers (L325-331) and 4/6 'She' density from L321; cap 0. This fix clears both.
findings.suggestedFix: The end slid out when she tried to tuck it under.

findings.text: The bar was on the outside.
findings.reason: Third consecutive paragraph opening 'The' (L617-621); cap 0.
findings.suggestedFix: But the bar was on the outside.
